title: Outgoing mail servers
description: Configure SMTP servers for this company. Lower sequence is tried first.

help.title: About Outgoing mail servers
help.overview: Outgoing mail servers provide SMTP delivery for this company. New servers start inactive and should be activated only after a successful connection test.

sections.title: Configuration
items: Enter a name, host, port, encryption and authentication type, and a required From email address.
Username and password are optional when the chosen authentication allows it. From name and Reply-To are also optional.
Use Test connection before activating a server.

sections.title: Delivery order
items: A lower priority or sequence number is tried first.
Only active, non-deleted servers can send mail.
Deleting a server is a soft delete and it can be restored.

failDescription: An error occurred while loading SMTP servers. Please try again.
